content: Kwara ghǝr ma Kristi
Kwakyarvad ndzǝgana kwara ghǝra iin wa ngǝdlakiyam nǝ Kristi. Mbakyarvad kwaha ghacamaghacǝg bad ndzǝɗa, gwiya vǝlambi dlaɓ kǝ ghǝraru da mazhagyil kǝ zuukiya ɛva biya.
Aiciya, cinngamcinnga, kai Bulus wa tagkur kwana, akwama haiyamanthaig ɓagkuraa nǝ uud kǝ aguvaca, mbats maay nǝ tlǝra Kristi vakaru biya.
Ən gwiya ba tagkurtag taakiya, baɗǝm daddakwa haiganthaig gata adzahadzaha ɓa aguvaca, nalnǝg barari gatǝgaan kǝ adzahadzaha muus baɗǝma.
Kuuramǝn am ɓa kǝlandzǝɗaru kǝ tlǝkǝna nǝg kwal haip tǝvuukwa Daadamazhigǝl tǝdvad gata adzahadzaha Muusa, samdalsǝg kǝ ghǝraru ma gata Kistiya. Tǝrɗamatǝrɗǝg tǝ herǝra Daadamazhigǝla.
Aɗaba tǝdvad Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla ard fadghǝra, nǝ wa kiyam pakkǝg nǝ miyam dǝ fantaar kǝ tlǝkǝna jiijjira.

Aɗaba ma kiiyam dǝ Kristi Yesu nǝ miiyama, aanji ɓagakaɓag nǝ uud kǝ aguvaca, aanji ɓagakaabi nǝ uud biya, maay tlǝran vakamnd biya. Dǝgiti maraw vakamnda, iinfadghǝra kwa mara ghǝran tǝdvad waiyakǝvǝra.
Ba zunngw am za vuuk ba vaivaiya. War wa tsakurva kǝ gata dǝga jiijiii?
Hulfa kwan kǝ valla uuda sahi vak Daadamazhigǝl kwa ɗahakurǝtɗahǝg biya.
Bandkwa tagavdan taakiya, “Zǝr yisti ba hǝɗiikǝn wa fǝgara ciig kǝ bǝruudiya.”
Mbakyarvad hweɗa miyam ma Kristiya, fandghǝrfǝg naiy taakiya am maay gata kwatlǝrn kǝ ǝlbǝg shah dǝ dǝgar biya. Daddakwa na ciya hǝnkalaruwa da vǝlvarvǝlǝg nǝ dlaɗa, aanji ba war nǝ iina.

Zaraabahara, akwama gwastaan ǝn taa ba ǝlbǝg marawa tǝghǝr kǝ ɓa aguvac naiya, aujilɓǝg kaci kǝ uudaha gwastaan ar vǝlgwa ba dlaɗi? Akwama bandkwaha, ǝlɓǝgar tǝghǝr kǝ ǝmtsǝga Kristi tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝga nalbi kǝ dǝga mɓǝɗa uud tǝ ɗuul biya!
Lii ar ciya hǝnkalaruna, ngulǝm mara datlant kǝ ghǝratǝra!

Zaraabaha, ɗahakurantɗahǝg nǝ uud kiyava kwaraghǝra. Famfǝg kǝ kyǝmiya analbi nǝ kwaraghǝraru kǝ dǝga ɓa dǝgiti naag nǝ vǝgh biya. Dlakulvakwaha ɓagamɓag kǝ tlǝr dǝ kwaraghǝraru am waigan kǝ zaraabaharuwa.
Aɗaba baɗǝm tsagaana adzahadzaha Muusa ghaca bad dǝgit palla kwa taakiya, “Waiga kǝ zǝraabagha band ghǝragha.”
Akwama am zavǝghad zaraabaharuwa dlaɓa am hadzakava, famfǝg kǝ hǝnkala, badzamdabi kǝ ghǝraru biya.
Sahsaha Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla ard ndzǝgana vǝgha
Naagara, ɓagamɓag kǝ ndzǝgani naag nǝ Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla. Akwama ɓagamaɓag ǝndkwana, am maay gata ndzǝgana vǝgh biya.

Aɗaba ndzǝna vǝgha haigant bi dǝ Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl biya, shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl dlaɓa haigant bi dǝ ndzǝgana vǝgha biya. Kwanaham kǝ hǝnkal buwaǝna ar ɓa tlǝghum dǝ ghǝrahatǝra. Iin wam ɓagǝnabi nǝ uuram kǝ dǝgiti am naag nǝ uuram kǝ ɓagan biya.
Akwama Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl wa ɓa tlǝr dǝ kǝ uurama, am mazhagil kǝ tsaga adzahadzaha Muus biya.
Tlǝrahi kwa ɓag nǝ ndzǝgana vǝgha maradamarǝg ba tǝ ɓalaɓala. Iitǝr nǝ ɓa kuuya, ɓa gwaragwara, ard gata cinnga ǝmtakǝra kwa dǝga tsa zhiruwa,
ard ɓa kwatǝnahǝr kǝ ghǝlla, ard uukya, ard naabi kǝ zǝraaba, uushava, sǝlga kǝ zǝraaba, nguɗa ǝrviɗmahuɗa, naa ghǝra, ard tlakwatsiga,

ard sǝlga ard tsǝg nǝ kya, ard hulfa tǝr baɗǝma. Ən ɓǝlkur kǝ kiiɓa ndaiga, band kwa tangankur nai ba wurwur taakiya lii ɓa hulfa kwanahan kǝ dǝgita ar da tlǝkǝnabi kǝ dǝga gwiig ma tlǝksǝra Daadamazhigǝl biya.
Dǝgiti vǝlǝg nǝ Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝla iin nǝ waiyakǝva, ard panahnaha ǝrviɗmahuɗa, ard gabǝrǝra, ard fa ǝrviɗmahuɗa, ard jiira,
ard kalaliya ard agha ɗuuwant kǝ dǝgiti naag nǝ vǝgha. Lii ɓa hulfa kwan kǝ dǝgitaha da maay tǝvtǝr nǝ shari biya.
Baɗǝm nǝ lii dǝga Kristi Yesu hǝrtarǝthǝrtǝg kǝ tlǝra vǝgha ard dǝgitah shahshah kwa naag nǝ vǝgha.
Vǝlakiyamvǝlg tsau ba nǝ Shiɗkwa Daadamazhigǝl kǝ shifǝga, aa ɓa nǝ Shiɗkwa kǝ tlǝr dǝ kǝmyam ma ndzǝgana miyam baɗǝmma.
Niyamalbi kǝ lii dǝ dǝkdǝka ghǝr biya, bi lii ciya hǝnkala zaraabah biya, bi lii naabi kǝ zaraabah biya.
